# Decision 1: Establish Royal Cipher Bureau (设立常设御前密电局)
oe_dip2_dec_establish_cipher_bureau = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		current_year >= 1437
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_bureau_mod }
	}
	allow = {
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 200
		prestige >= 10
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { gold >= 600 }
			add = 10
		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:nobles
			background = pop_type:burghers
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_dip2_dec_establish_cipher_bureau.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -200
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dip2_cipher_bureau_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
			oe_dip2_bump_ops_count = yes
		}
	}
}
